plugins.name: luna-correlate
plugins.description: Offline health-factor correlation MCP (Posture A). Cross-references local health/status series against external factors — Kp geomagnetic index (date-only) and location factors (barometric pressure, pollen, air-quality) resolved offline via a proximity index — and surfaces ranked CANDIDATE signals with caveats; never a diagnosis, never causation. Only the gated factors.cache fetcher touches the network (country-level grid, no PHI, no operator coordinates).

plugins.name: himmel-ops
plugins.description: Harness-meta operational skills for himmel. Load-on-trigger guardrail-recovery playbook (stuck-playbook) that surfaces escape-hatches when an auto-mode write is denied, a Bash command falls through to the classifier, a permission prompt hangs, or a pre-push gate fails — so operational/troubleshooting rules stay out of the always-on root CLAUDE.md.

plugins.name: himmel-guard

Upstream advance is detected at the release level by the superpowers-skills and mattpocock-skills rows in scripts/upstreams.json; repair is a reviewed re-vendor, never a synced_base bump. See marketplace/plugins/lean-skills/VENDORED.md.
